props.name: context
props.meaning: The widget context. Every read goes through it, so widgets on a page share one cache.

props.name: root_path
props.meaning: Where the tree starts, `/Project/<id>`.

props.name: seed_path
props.meaning: Opens the tree down to this path, or to the last entry of an incremental path.

props.name: checkable
props.meaning: Draws a checkbox per node and reports the checked rows.

props.name: selection_mode
props.meaning: How many nodes may be selected at once.

props.name: selection
props.meaning: Paths of the selected nodes, two-way.

props.name: expanded
props.meaning: Paths of the open nodes, two-way. Setting it opens exactly those, reading whatever level is not loaded.

props.name: is_row_disabled
props.meaning: True for a node the arrows skip and the selection refuses.

props.name: searchable
props.meaning: Shows an input that searches the project and opens the tree onto the hits.

props.name: search_placeholder
props.meaning: Placeholder and label of that input.

props.name: expand_depth
props.meaning: Levels a whole-branch expansion opens.

props.name: thumbnail
props.meaning: The image field to draw a thumbnail from.

props.name: label_field
props.meaning: Field shown as the label, in place of the tree's own.

props.name: sub_label_field
props.meaning: Field shown under the label. A resolved column renders it by type.

props.name: sub_label
props.meaning: Muted line under the label. Wins over `subLabelField`.

props.name: secondary_field
props.meaning: Right-aligned field, drawn by its data type. A resolved column renders it by type.

props.name: secondary
props.meaning: Right-aligned text. Wins over `secondaryField`.

props.name: show_code
props.meaning: Show the schema name beside the label on a node that stands for a type.

props.name: fields
props.meaning: Extra fields to request, so a caller's own sub-label or secondary can read them.

props.name: site_url
props.meaning: The site the status sprite is served from.

props.name: label
props.meaning: Accessible name of the tree.

props.name: max_height
props.meaning: Height of the scrolling body.

props.name: empty_label
props.meaning: Shown when the root has no children.

props.name: no_match_label
props.meaning: Shown when a search matched no row.

props.name: loading_label
props.meaning: Names the skeletons a read stands behind, for a screen reader.

props.name: error_label
props.meaning: Shown in place of what the failed read said.

props.name: size
props.meaning: Row text, leading slot and glyphs, and the search input on the control ladder.

props.name: density
props.meaning: Compact halves the vertical row padding and draws a row chip and badge a step smaller.

events.name: selected
events.when: A node with nothing under it was chosen.

events.name: checked_changed
events.when: The checked set changed. Only nodes that stand for a row are reported.

slots.name: row
slots.receives: `{ node, id, level, expanded, selected, disabled, match }`
slots.draws: Draws a row's contents: everything after the chevron and the checkbox.

keyboard.does: Moves to the next visible node.
Moves to the previous visible node.
Opens a closed branch, else moves to its first child.
Closes an open branch, else moves to its parent.
Moves to the last visible node.
Opens every branch at the focus level, `expandDepth` levels deep.
In the search input, clears it.
Moves to the next node whose label starts with what was typed. The same letter again walks the matches.
